title: JD.com Outdoors Launches AI Smart Helmet: Supports Voice Order Acceptance, Route Navigation, and Order Note Reminders

content_html:
JD.com Express announced the launch of AI Smart Helmet, which will be gradually put into use in the near future. The first batch of products will be freely distributed to full-time JD.com Express riders, and will gradually cover all riders. The new device integrates functions such as AI voice assistant, intelligent route planning, merchant environment verification, and order note reminders, aiming to improve delivery efficiency, rider safety, and user service experience.

According to the official introduction, the AI smart helmet supports voice interaction throughout the process, allowing riders to complete tasks such as accepting orders and calling users without operating their phones, especially in complex environments like rainy days, reducing manual operations and improving delivery safety. In addition, the helmet has a "Single King Route" function, which digitizes the delivery experience accumulated by experienced riders, helping riders quickly find destinations such as complex communities and hidden buildings through voice navigation, reducing the chances of getting lost or taking detours, and improving delivery timeliness.

Furthermore, the AI smart helmet adds a "Merchant Environment Verification" function. When riders pick up meals at the store, they can use AI assistance to check the store environment. If any abnormalities are found, the system will automatically mark them, further complementing JD.com Express's previous in-store merchant identification system, enhancing the transparency of the platform's catering services.

For user experience, the helmet can automatically interpret order notes and proactively remind riders of special requirements before delivery, such as "just leave it at the door" or "do not ring the doorbell," reducing delivery issues caused by missed notes.

The release of the AI smart helmet marks JD.com Express's further integration of artificial intelligence technology into instant delivery scenarios, improving the efficiency, safety, and service quality of riders through smart hardware, and reflecting the accelerating penetration of AI into offline business links such as logistics and delivery.

content_html_zh:
京东快递宣布推出AI智能头盔，近期将逐步投入使用。 首批产品将免费发放给京东快递专职骑手，并逐步覆盖所有骑手。 新设备集成了AI语音助手、智能路线规划、商户环境验证、订单备注提醒等功能，旨在提高配送效率、骑手安全和用户服务体验。

据官方介绍，AI智能头盔支持全程语音交互，骑手无需操作手机即可完成接受订单、呼叫用户等任务，尤其是在雨天等复杂环境下，减少人工操作，提高配送安全性。 此外，头盔还具有“单王路线”功能，将经验丰富的骑手积累的配送经验数字化，帮助骑手通过语音导航快速找到复杂社区、隐藏建筑等目的地，减少迷路、走弯路的机会，提高配送时效。

此外，AI智能头盔还新增“商户环境验证”功能。 骑手到店取餐时，可以利用AI辅助查看店内环境。 如果发现异常，系统会自动标记，进一步补充了京东快递此前的店内商户识别系统，增强了平台餐饮服务的透明度。

在用户体验上，头盔可以自动解读订单备注，并在送货前主动提醒骑手特殊要求，例如“放在门口即可”或“请勿按门铃”，减少因漏单而导致的送货问题。

AI智能头盔的发布，标志着京东快递将人工智能技术进一步融入即时配送场景，通过智能硬件提升骑手的效率、安全性和服务质量，体现了人工智能加速渗透到物流配送等线下业务环节。
